analysis.executive_summary: TON documentation spans 465 crawled pages with 100% crawl coverage and zero confirmed broken links. API reference coverage stands at 64.09% across 136 detected API pages, leaving over one-third of API surface undocumented. SEO/geo issues affect 22.37% of pages, risking organic discovery and regional reach. Retrieval readiness scores 82.85/100 (strong band), with 90.09% of 1,463 key claims backed by evidence. Overall audit confidence is 63.5%, constrained by link verification limitations (8 unverified URLs due to auth/rate-limit blocks).
strengths: 100% crawl coverage (465 of 473 in-scope pages) with zero broken internal or repository navigation links
99.57% of pages include last-updated metadata, supporting freshness transparency
90.09% of 1,463 detected claims are backed by evidence, strengthening trust and AI answer quality
Example reliability estimate at 99.63%, indicating minimal code-rot risk in tutorials
Retrieval readiness overall score of 82.85 (strong band) with 100% citationability and 88.39% chunkability
risks: 35.91% of API surface lacks usage documentation (136 API pages detected, 64.09% coverage), blocking developer onboarding for uncovered endpoints
22.37% SEO/geo issue rate threatens organic search visibility and regional discoverability, directly impacting inbound developer acquisition
8 unverified links (auth/rate-limit/server blocks) introduce unknown broken-link exposure; link confidence is only 25%
17.63% of pages fail answerability checks, limiting effectiveness in LLM-powered search and chatbot contexts
11.61% of pages have chunkability issues, risking poor semantic retrieval in vector search and RAG pipelines
2.07% stale-risk pages may contain outdated guidance, eroding trust if not flagged or refreshed
Overall audit confidence at 63.5% means findings may undercount issues in link health and edge-case API detection

prioritized_actions.action: Close the 35.91% API documentation gap by generating usage examples and parameter guides for the 49 undocumented API pages (out of 136 detected)
prioritized_actions.why_this_first: Undocumented APIs block developer onboarding and integration velocity, directly reducing time-to-first-transaction and increasing support load for missing endpoint guidance.

prioritized_actions.action: Remediate SEO/geo issues on the 104 affected pages (22.37% of 465) by adding missing meta descriptions, fixing duplicate titles, and ensuring regional hreflang tags
prioritized_actions.why_this_first: SEO fixes unlock organic search traffic and regional discoverability, expanding top-of-funnel developer acquisition with minimal engineering dependency.

prioritized_actions.action: Improve answerability for the 82 pages (17.63%) failing LLM-readiness checks by adding explicit Q&A pairs, summary sections, or structured how-to blocks
prioritized_actions.why_this_first: Answerability gaps degrade performance in AI-powered search and chatbots, reducing self-service success and increasing support ticket volume as LLM adoption grows.

prioritized_actions.action: Resolve chunkability issues on 54 pages (11.61%) by breaking long prose into subsections, adding headings, and splitting dense tables
prioritized_actions.why_this_first: Chunkability fixes improve vector search and RAG retrieval precision, boosting AI-assisted onboarding and reducing time-to-answer for embedded search features.

prioritized_actions.action: Verify the 8 unverified links (auth/rate-limit blocked) manually or via authenticated crawl, then fix or document any confirmed breaks
prioritized_actions.why_this_first: Unverified links introduce hidden broken-link risk that erodes trust and disrupts user journeys; low-effort manual check closes the 25% link-confidence gap.

automation_first: Deploy automated SEO linter in CI/CD to flag missing meta descriptions, duplicate titles, and hreflang gaps on every commit, preventing recurrence of the 22.37% issue rate and ensuring new pages launch search-optimized.

Implement nightly API schema diff scanner to detect new or changed endpoints not yet documented, auto-filing GitHub issues for the 49 undocumented APIs and preventing future coverage drift below the current 64.09%.

Add pre-commit answerability and chunkability checks using LLM-based scoring to block merges of pages failing the 17.63% answerability threshold, reducing support load and improving RAG retrieval quality at authoring time.
limitations: External audit cannot verify the 8 auth/rate-limit-blocked URLs; actual broken-link count may be higher than zero, and link confidence remains at 25%.
API detection relies on heuristic pattern matching; no_api_pages_found is false, but edge-case endpoints (e.g., webhooks, admin APIs) may be undercounted in the 136-page total.
Freshness metadata (99.57% coverage) reflects presence of last-updated fields, not accuracy; pages may be marked current despite outdated content.
Example reliability estimate (99.63%) is static analysis; runtime execution, dependency drift, and environment-specific failures are not tested.
Audit confidence of 63.5% means findings are conservative; true issue counts for links, API coverage, and retrieval readiness may be 10–20% higher in production use.
